summary: Set ca_tls_cert and ca_tls_key to have the installer generate all service certificates signed by your own CA, without per-service certificate variables.
questions: How do I make AAP sign certificates with my CA?
Do I need gateway_tls_cert if I set ca_tls_cert?

answer_card.title: Sign all certs with your CA
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
ca_tls_cert=<path_to_ca_tls_certificate>
ca_tls_key=<path_to_ca_tls_key>
```
The installer then creates every service certificate from this CA; no `gateway_tls_cert`, `controller_tls_cert` and so on needed.
